name: confiscate_takes_a_noncreature_permanent
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Enchant permanent. You control enchanted permanent.' Seat 0 casts Confiscate on seat 1's artifact, a noncreature permanent (Enchant permanent allows it): while the Aura is attached seat 0 controls the artifact; seat 1's other artifact is untouched.
